row:
PhysioLogic is an initiative taken by Dr. Sheeraz Shehzad PT to help medical students who are struggling with their studies.
I have a firm belief that every topic in medical education has a Logic and if students are able to understand that Logic, learning becomes easier.

"A Physiotherapist teaching you Logic - PhysioLogic"
